narrative:
## Handover Summary — Capital Investment

Capex validated by programme with depreciation profiles.

## Key Decisions
• AI & automation platform programme kept at GBP 22M
• Synergy BPS mobilisation phased into H2 FY2026 and FY2027
• Site consolidation linked to the contact centre disposal and Regulated Services exit

## Recommendation for Consolidation
Test free cash flow against the 2027 positive free cash flow ambition before the board submission.

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.
